epizode.naslov: I let Cloudflare's AI security auditor loose on my app | Dev's Pick #1
epizode.sazetak: Michael, a full-stack developer, ran Cloudflare's AI security auditor on his own app: 5 findings in 1m 32s. Simple to set up, detailed results. His tip: run it segment by segment.
epizode.xPost:
I ran Cloudflare's AI security auditor on my own app.

1m 32s later: 5 findings, each with who can reach it, what they get, and how to fix it.

My take after 10 years as a full-stack dev: very easy to set up and practical, but run it on one part of the app at a time. It works better.

8/10. Would you let an AI audit your code?
